复制 AI 吐出的 Markdown，悬停「创建 MD」就变成一页排版完整的文档。三条通道按环境自动降级，本地 file:// 下按一次 Ctrl+V 也能成文。
Paste Markdown from your AI, hover "Create MD" and it becomes a fully typeset document. Three fallback channels adapt to the environment, so a single Ctrl+V still works under local file://.
复制 → 开编辑器 → 存盘 → 再拖进阅读器
Copy → open editor → save → drag into reader
复制、悬停、点击，三步成文
Copy, hover, click — a document in three steps
选中两列就出图：柱状 / 折线 / 趋势 / 圆角环形 / 南丁格尔玫瑰，外加自动选型。环形扇区角度按百分比精确累计，可以拿量角器验算。

Select two columns and a chart appears: bar / line / trend / rounded donut / Nightingale rose, with automatic type selection. Donut sectors accumulate angles by percentage, so you can verify them with a protractor.
预览器只给一张静态表
A previewer that only gives you a static table
角度即百分比，数据经得起追问
Angle equals percentage; the data stands up to scrutiny
Mermaid 原生、文本箭头、Unicode 框线字符画三条入口，统一落到同一张可拖拽编辑的矢量图；5 种结构 × 5 套风格 = 25 种外观。
Mermaid, text arrows and Unicode box-drawing all feed one editable vector diagram; 5 structures × 5 styles = 25 looks.
画图工具要联网、要订阅、导出死图
Diagramming tools need internet, subscriptions and export dead images
纯本地算法识别，零调用、可编辑
Pure local recognition — no calls, no waiting, still editable
四套文档风格不是只改强调色：分段背景、图表色板、流程图强调色、代码关键字同时换装。
Four document styles do more than recolor the accent: section backgrounds, chart palettes, flowchart accents and code keywords all change together.
一份文档里三种蓝、两种红
One document with three blues and two reds
换风格不会出现「深底压深字」
Changing style never produces dark text on dark ground
Obsidian 的 [[双链]]、![[嵌入]]、Callout 提示块、YAML frontmatter、#标签 开箱即渲染；上千文件的库拖进来就能读。
Obsidian [[links]], ![[embeds]], Callouts, YAML frontmatter and #tags render out of the box; drop in a library of thousands of files and it just reads.
先导入整库，再装一堆社区插件
Import the whole vault first, then install a pile of community plugins
拖入文件夹即建树，打开就是能读的页面
Drop in a folder to build the tree; open it and it reads
独立 HTML 保留交互——图表可切型、CSV 可复制、表格可排序；Word 与打印 PDF 保真排版，SVG 和 Markdown 源码一键带走。
Standalone HTML keeps its interactions — switch chart types, copy CSV, sort tables; Word and print PDF keep the layout, and SVG plus Markdown source export in one click.
导出就是一张死了的图
导出 = 当前 DOM 克隆，即最后编辑态
Export = a clone of the current DOM, i.e. your last edit
mdlens 同时提供 CLI / HTTP / MCP 三种接入，AI 工具直接把 Markdown 渲染成页面；引擎内联在本地。
mdlens speaks CLI / HTTP / MCP, so AI tools render Markdown straight into pages; the engine is inlined locally.
在聊天窗口里读竖线和反引号
Reading pipes and backticks inside a chat window
Agent 自己渲染，用户只负责校对
The agent renders; you only proofread
侧栏大纲点标题即跳；编辑切成独立小块，只重渲染受影响那块，几万字的大表格也不乱序。
Click any heading in the sidebar outline to jump; editing is split into independent blocks and only the affected one re-renders, so huge tables stay in order.
整篇塞进 textarea，一保存 diff 全炸
The whole file in one textarea; one save and the diff explodes
Block-level edits dirty only that block
卡片 = 分节面板 + 深色编号头部；纸张 = 描图纸面 + 装订刻度 + 衬线标题。配色、字体、圆角整套切换。
Card = sectioned panel with dark numbered headers; Paper = drafting sheet with binding marks and serif titles. Colors, fonts and radii switch as a set.
所谓皮肤就是换个边框颜色
A "skin" that just changes a border color
衬线 / 无衬线、圆角 / 直角成套换
Serif / sans, rounded / square — switched as a set
最多 30 条记录。点历史时按绝对路径重读磁盘原文，不是打开一张旧快照；文件被移走自动退回正文缓存。
Up to 30 entries. Clicking history re-reads the file from disk by absolute path rather than opening a stale snapshot; if the file moved it falls back to the cached body.
缓存快照，改完还看老内容
A cached snapshot that still shows the old content
昨天改过的，今天点进来就是最新
What you changed yesterday is what you see today
语言、排版、字号 12–22px、行高四档、皮肤、柔光、图表自动展开、流程图结构与风格——分三组卡片，每项都有一句人话解释。
Language, layout, font size 12–22px, four line heights, skin, soft light, chart auto-expand, flowchart structure and style — in three grouped cards, each explained in plain words.
一屏看不懂的黑话开关
A screen of jargon switches nobody understands
全部本地记忆，不登录、不上传
Everything remembered locally — no login, no upload
一键隐去侧栏与工具条，只留正文和阅读进度；渲染快捷菜单仍然可用，专注不等于砍功能。
Hide the sidebar and toolbar in one click, leaving only the text and reading progress; the render menu still works, because focus should not mean losing features.
折叠面板，功能跟着一起消失
Collapse the panels and the features vanish too
Cut only the noise, not the capability
柔光覆盖顶栏、侧栏、标签栏、阅读区、弹层，一处不落；色阶连续不出现「贴上去的一块」。
Soft light covers the toolbar, sidebar, tab bar, reading area and overlays with none left out; the gradient stays continuous, with no visible patch.
夜间模式 = 背景调暗、文字调亮
Night mode = darker background, brighter text
全链路同一条渐变色阶，可与三主题叠加
One continuous gradient across the app, stackable with all three themes
护眼是低蓝光暖米黄（卡片 #faf3e0 / 纸张 #fdf3d8 + 琥珀褐强调），与纯白一眼可辨。
Eye care is a low-blue warm beige (card #faf3e0 / paper #fdf3d8 with an amber accent), unmistakably different from plain white.
白底加一点点黄就叫护眼
Any white background with a hint of yellow called eye care
三种主题各自成套，不是盖一层滤镜
Three complete themes, not a filter pasted on top
简体中文 / English / 跟随系统。运行时按 key 长度降序替换，未收录词条保留中文原文，不会冒出大片 undefined。
Simplified Chinese / English / follow system. Replacements run longest-key first, and missing entries keep the Chinese original instead of showing undefined.
半机翻的界面，顺手把正文也翻了
Half machine-translated UI that translates your text too
只翻界面文案，文档正文一个字不动
UI text only; document bodies stay untouched
